![critical](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/critical.svg)

This block has a critical flaw: it will raise an `IndexError` if `sequence_keys` is empty, causing a crash. This occurs for samples without sequence data.

The `else` branch is also redundant, as the logic at lines 163-166 ensures `sequence_keys[0]` is always in `actual_lengths` when `sequence_keys` is not empty.

The suggested change fixes the crash and simplifies the logic.

```suggestion
                if sequence_keys:
                    L = actual_lengths[sequence_keys[0]]
                else:
                    L = 0
```
